sentences.text: This is the third bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/ 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.290/2024 registered at Police Station - Maihar, District - Maihar, Satna (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(D)(A), 506, 450, 34, 376(3), 201 and 323 of the IPC and Sections 5/6 and 4(2) of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station - Maihar, District - Maihar, Satna
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The applicant is in custody since 31.03.2024.
2.

Applicant's first application i.e. M.Cr.C. No.47700/2024 was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 11.02.2025 and second application i.e. M.Cr.C. No.29395/2025 was also dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to repeat the application after recording the statement of victim before the trial Court vide order dated 14.08.2025.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the statement NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:55248 2 MCRC-48815-2025 of the victim has been recorded and in her statement she has denied that any act has been caused by the applicant.
DNA report is negative, therefore, no allegation remains for which the applicant could be kept behind the Bars.
Trial will take time to be concluded, hence, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and has submitted that no case of bail is made out, hence, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

5. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: Looking to the factual aspect that the victim in her childhood was brought by the mother of this applicant and applicant's mother nourished and brought up the victim in the same house and the applicant is so called brother of the victim and it is but natural that she cannot survive after giving the evidence against her brother, therefore, only on the ground that the victim has turned hostile, no case of bail is made out.
Therefore, this Court does not deem it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on bail, hence, this bail application is dismissed.
7. Trial Court is directed to expedite the matter as early as possible.
8. Accordingly, Misc. Criminal Case stands disposed of.
